messages:
meera: Hey team — AcmeCorp POC asking for a secure drop to upload SOC2/ISO artifacts + signed pen-test letter. They want SFTP access to push files and a contact to confirm receipt. Can we do a short-lived acct?

sam: We can provide an SFTP account scoped to a single folder, 7-day TTL. Need: list of filenames, contact email, and whether any artifacts contain customer-owned PII so we can redact.

meera: Thanks. They’ll upload: soc2_report_2025.pdf, iso27001_scope.docx, pentest_attestation_signed.pdf, network_diagrams.zip. Contact: alice@acmecorp.com. No customer PII expected. ETA from them: tomorrow morning.

katie: I can spin up an SFTP user in the evidence-bucket. Command for the client: `sftp -i /path/to/key acme@evidence.redwood.ai` (we'll hand off the key). I’ll set expiration to 2025-03-05T12:00Z. Do we need IP allowlist?

sam: Yes add IP allowlist to be safe. Ask Acme for their upload IPs; else we can restrict to their VPN egress CIDR. Also, we can't share KMS private keys. If they want to verify encryption at rest, we can provide a KMS-wrapped export of object metadata and a statement from our security team.

eli: Quick Q — will this evidence drop be for a Hosted API POC or Dedicated? The level of network detail differs.

meera: Hosted API POC. They asked for network diagrams to validate separation controls but not a dedicated network.

sam: OK hosted. For the pentest attestation: legal needs the signed letter PDF (scanned). We require the letter to have vendor name + signature + date. If it mentions internal IPs, we recommend redacting or marking as sensitive before upload.

katie: Uploaded mounting info for them: sftp://evidence.redwood.ai/acme_poc/ — will DM the private key to alice@acmecorp.com via 2FA link. Example path layout we expect: `/acme_poc/01_soc2/soc2_report_2025.pdf`, `/acme_poc/02_iso/iso27001_scope.docx`, `/acme_poc/03_pentest/pentest_attestation_signed.pdf`

meera: Can someone draft the short acceptance note we send after they upload? Need to confirm receipt + checksum + deletion policy.

sam: Use this template: "Received files: [list]. Checksums match: [sha256 sums]. Files will be retained in evidence-bucket for 30 days and then purged unless an NDA/contract says otherwise. Contact security@redwood.ai for questions." I’ll generate checksums after upload.

sec-bot: Reminder: compliance-evidence uploads must be scanned for secrets. Auto-scan queued; results will post here.

meera: Perfect. I’ll relay SFTP details to Acme and ask for their upload IPs. ETA: will update thread when they confirm or if key delivery fails. :thumbsup:

katie: FYI I set the account TTL and put a heads-up in my calendar to revoke at expiry. I’ll also open a short tracking ticket: https://redwood.ai/ops/issue/INC-44221

alice@acmecorp.com: (joined thread) Thanks — we got the key DM and will start uploading first thing tomorrow. Who should we ping if the upload fails?

meera: Ping me + sam. I'll be on the POC check-in at 09:30.

sam: After upload, please include a small readme.txt with the uploader name and upload timestamp. We’ll run the secret-scan and checksum. If anything flagged, we’ll contact you before taking action.

meera: Closing loop — expected final confirmation by 2025-02-28 EOD. I’ll post the checksums here once sam runs them. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
